title: Mothership Decision Approval v0
description: A human judgment bound cryptographically to exactly one Decision Card via canonical JSON SHA-256 digest. Valid only while unexpired. DISTINCT from approval-event.schema.json, which is invocation/execution-side evidence binding alias + registry + task + prompt + scope. decision-approval does NOT constitute execution authority; it records that a human reviewed this exact Card content. Card mutation invalidates this approval. Use validate_decision_approval_binding() from mothership.contracts to verify the binding mechanically.
